title: broadcast recv() cancel-safety: correct under disconnect
description: broadcast::Receiver::recv() is not cancel-safe per Tokio docs (lagged position may change), but the only case where live_tx.closed() fires and cancels the recv() future is when the client has disconnected, causing the task to break out of the loop entirely. The cancelled recv() future's in-progress slot stays in the ring buffer — no message is lost to other subscribers. The task exits cleanly. No correctness issue.
